name: hero
facts: Every skill lives at skills/<name>/SKILL.md, with optional reference/, scripts/, and assets/ directories
npx skills add apatheticus/skills writes editable copies of the skills into a project
The Claude Code channel adds the marketplace, then installs apatheticus-skills@apatheticus as a managed bundle
Both channels read the same skills/ directory; the plugin manifest sources the repository root
scripts/validate.mjs validates every skill and both plugin manifests
